name: boom-tage-l
description: BOOM v4 withTAGELBPD predictor sizes as a component study (all presets small..giga share it).

approximations: TAGE index/tag hashing, allocation and u-bit clearing follow the generic csim TAGE, not BOOM's folded-history and wrbypass logic
BOOM predicts per fetch bank (bankWidth columns); csim predicts per branch instruction
BIM is modelled as one 2048-entry table; BOOM banks it by column
the FA2 micro BTB, slow BTB fill timing and banking are not modelled; the BTB is one 256-entry 2-way level
the loop predictor uses the Seznec rules with 3-bit confidence (BOOM threshold 7), not BOOM's exact update
history is speculative in BOOM and repaired; csim trains on the actual path with immediate update
RAS repair follows the csim pointer_top policy
